Nystad AE et al. 2014 APMIS, PMID 24862867 (abstract via Europe PMC; cited by the PRIDE sample protocol for the animal work)

claims.evidence: PRIDE organisms NEWT:10090; sample protocol 'C57Bl/6 mice'; PD table descriptions 'OS=Mus musculus'
PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol 'cuprizone administration of C57Bl/6 mice'; Nystad 2014 abstract 'female C57Bl/6 mice'
Nystad 2014 abstract 'female C57Bl/6 mice were demyelinated with dietary 0.2% cuprizone for 7 weeks'; PRIDE protocol states the animal work is described in Nystad et al., APMIS, 2014
PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol 'individual mouse brain samples (right frontal including some corpus callosum)'

claims.value: demyelinating disease of central nervous system (MONDO:0020800)
claims.evidence: All six groups were cuprizone-demyelinated for 7 weeks (protocol: 'mice after 7 weeks of cuprizone demyelination including injections ... with either vitD or placebo', then remyelination after withdrawal). Placebo is vehicle injection, not a healthy arm. PRIDE 'multiple sclerosis' is the modelled human disease, not a diagnosis of the mice
Protocol: 'intra-peritoneal injections of 1,25-(OH)2D3 or placebo'; Nystad 2014 'calcitriol or placebo (vehicle)'; PD ratio headers 'D7/Pl7' etc.

claims.evidence: Project description: 'Brain samples were taken after 7 weeks (demyelinated), after 8 weeks (1 week remyelination) and after 10 weeks (3 weeks of remyelination)'

claims.evidence: Data processing protocol lists exactly these; deposited PD peptide table Modifications column contains only N-Term(TMT6plex) 60880, K(TMT6plex) 42300, C(Carbamidomethyl) 9191, M(Oxidation) 1883

limitations: Primary paper (Oveland 2017, Neurochem Int) is not open access; only its abstract was read. All design details come from the PRIDE protocol text, the Nystad 2014 abstract and the deposited PD peptide table.
Sex (female) comes from the Nystad 2014 abstract, which the PRIDE protocol cites for the animal work; the PRIDE record itself does not state sex.
Developmental stage / age of the mice is not stated in any accessible source; written as 'not available'.
Individual mouse identities in each pool are not deposited; pooled sample is written as 'pooled' without SN= members.
Fraction identifiers are ordinal positions (1-54), not the original HPLC well numbers (pooled 1-3, then 8-60).
Reduction and alkylation reagents are not stated; the columns are omitted.
PRIDE 'softwares' lists MaxQuant, but the protocol and the deposited table show Proteome Discoverer 1.4 (MS Amanda, Mascot, SequestHT); this does not affect any SDRF column.
